summary: The First Den is currently a sunny, effectively endless forest floor crossed by winding rivers, with the spawn clearing and square door amid procedural woodland. One main place combines generated terrain and multi-layer forest scatter with a sparse set of authored cells; player movement, first-person camera, interaction hooks and a conditional dragon-riding HUD remain wired, while the dragon itself is currently represented only by a blueprint placeholder.
places: places/main - sole live 3D place; forest-terrain drives the heightmap and river sea mark, with forest decoration layers and authored forest/door/ambience rows
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - spawn clearing, square-door assembly, sunbeam effect, forest ambience, forest scatter roots and the jade-dragon blueprint placeholder
places/main/cells/x-1z0.scene - authored river-sound emitter at the river near the spawn region
places/main/cells/ - remaining cells carry sparse authored landscape/forest rows around the spawn; x0z-1.scene and x0z1.scene are empty
roots: world.config.yaml - world entry for default place main, multiplayer, arrival behavior, player/camera, lighting, input and UI render hook
templates/player.js#player - character root with player movement, humanoid locomotion and home-player-feel behavior
templates/camera.js#camera - custom first-person camera driven by look orientation
places/main/config.yaml - place runtime root: spawn/gravity, forest heightmap and materials, river mark, clearing and procedural vegetation layers
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#square-door - authored portal/door root to the square with approach/passages, framing and sign
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#jade-dragon - blueprint box at the west lawn; no jade-dragon behavior or procedural dragon geometry is attached
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#sunbeams - follow-camera forest pollen/sunbeam particle effect
shared: scripts/forest-terrain.js - place heightAt/materialAt contract for ground, winding water channels and terrain material bands
scripts/gen/forest-plant.js + scripts/gen/valley-mesh.js - forest vegetation geometry helpers; place layers reuse forest-plant variants
scripts/lib/data/dragon.js - shared dragon tuning imported by camera, rider helper, clip code and dragon behavior
scripts/lib/dragon-rider.js - rider-side mount handoff/seat/step-off logic used by scripts/home-player-feel.js
scripts/lib/home-interaction.js + scripts/lib/data/home-feel.js - interaction search/tuning retained by player feel behavior
scripts/lib/data/camera.yml - first-person camera tuning consumed by scripts/camera.js
notableExports: scripts/flat-terrain.js - exports constant-zero heightAt and white materialAt
scripts/gen/forest-plant.js - exports geometry(ctx), collider(ctx) for broadleaf, sapling, shrub, fern, reed and log
scripts/gen/jade-dragon.js - exports radiusAt, centreY, skeleton, weightsAt, geometry and collider for the articulated body
scripts/jade-dragon.js - exports ears, onSpawn, onControlEnd, onInput and update for the dragon actor
scripts/camera.js - exports finiteNumber and update(ctx,dt); scripts/ui.js - default render function for dragon riding controls
ownership: places/main/config.yaml + scripts/forest-terrain.js - own configured terrain generator/seed/material mapping and derived terrain height and material selection
places/main/config.yaml - owns forest scatter layer densities, constraints, seeds, variant parameters, river/clearing terrain marks and decoration budget
places/main/cells/*.scene - own authored row ids, placements, transforms and row state; current jade-dragon row is only a blueprint placeholder
scripts/player.js - owns player movement input and body velocity/jump behavior; scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js owns locomotion/yaw channels
scripts/home-player-feel.js + scripts/lib/dragon-rider.js - write player interaction and mount/rider attachment state when a dragon target is present
scripts/camera.js - writes local camera position/view and hides the local player; dragon seat-eye placement is conditional on controlled target state.kind === 'dragon'
scripts/jade-dragon.js - if attached to a live actor, owns its mode/rider and flight/landing state; scripts/lib/data/dragon.js owns shared movement, saddle, sound and clip tuning
flows: places/main/config.yaml terrain.generator + seed -> scripts/forest-terrain.js heightAt/materialAt(ctx) -> engine terrain heightmap and forest/river material bands
place decorations layers/bindings -> scripts/gen/forest-plant.js variants and valley-tree.js -> seeded canopy, midstory, shrubs, ferns, ground, logs and reeds
moveX/moveZ and camera aim input -> scripts/player.js -> player movement intent/velocity and jump; place gravity applies to character body
move/look input -> scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js -> player yaw and gait channels
player body target -> scripts/camera.js -> first-person eye position/view; controlled dragon target instead uses DRAGON.seatEye
interact input -> scripts/home-player-feel.js + scripts/lib/home-interaction.js -> nearest in-reach/look-aligned interactable press; dragon tags also request mount through dragon-rider.js

mountWant/rider state <-> scripts/lib/dragon-rider.js and scripts/jade-dragon.js -> dragon assigns rider/control and rider helper seats or steps off; no live dragon behavior row currently receives this flow
dragon actor mode -> restClip()/flyClip() -> articulated spine animation; scripts/ui.js reads player.controlling.state.kind/mode and shows ride/landing controls only for a dragon
scene square-door approach/passage triggers -> scripts/square-door.js -> portal link/door behavior and authored sign/frame provide the square transition
forest-ambience row and x-1z0.scene river-sound row -> spatial/non-spatial Ambience audio playback
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/forest-plant.js + scripts/gen/valley-mesh.js - one procedural forest plant kit reused for canopy broadleaf trees, saplings, shrubs, ferns, reeds and logs, varied by kind, dimensions and seeds
places/main/config.yaml decoration layers - multi-scale forest scatter, varied by material binding, density, height/slope/water constraints, seed and wind settings; some layers reuse valley-tree.js
scripts/gen/valley-tree.js + valley-mesh.js + valley-outcrop.js - retained procedural forest tree and authored outcrop families, varied by crown/size/seed
scripts/jade-dragon.js + scripts/gen/jade-dragon.js + scripts/lib/dragon-clips.js - articulated rideable dragon behavior, procedural body and rest/fly clips; no active scene instance at this version
scripts/player.js + scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/home-player-feel.js - player controls, gait and interaction/rider integration attached by templates/player.js

scripts/gen/home-architecture-*.js, home-garden-*.js, castle-*.js, den-furniture*.js - legacy reusable building, garden, keep and furnishing families retained in the tree; current cleared spawn scene no longer instantiates the former keep/den layout
probableOrphans: scripts/flat-terrain.js - no current place config selects it; main uses scripts/forest-terrain.js
scripts/gen/jade-dragon.js - no current scene or template references the generator; dragon row is a blueprint box
scripts/jade-dragon.js - no current scene row attaches the actor behavior; home-player-feel/camera/UI contain conditional dragon integration only
migrationNotes: forest-terrain.js takes a context object for heightAt/materialAt; places/main uses a river sea mark at y=0, ground around y=0.5 and a flattening clearing centered at (0,-3), height 0.5.
places/main/config.yaml's forest decoration layers consume the specific terrain material ids litter, moss, mud and pebbles; preserve layer bindings and terrain return ids together.

The previous five-floor keep/den placement set was cleared from x0z0.scene; current home-root/building descriptions in design.md and older castle/home map facts do not describe the active spawn scene.

The current jade-dragon row is an engine/blueprint box, not the authored articulated actor. Dragon camera/player/UI integrations remain conditional; do not treat the old version-31 dragon instance as present.
scripts/gen/forest-plant.js reuses valley-mesh.js ring/loft/cap helpers; its feet are ground level and +Y is up, matching terrain decoration placements.
